review:
Mummy's Gold is a 5x3, 15-line Egyptian slot with straightforward features. Wilds triple any win they help complete, which gives the base game a decent boost.

After any base-game win, an optional gamble round lets you guess a hidden card's colour to double the win or its suit to quadruple it. Three or more scatters unlock free spins inside the mummy's tomb, with a chance to retrigger. BGaming rates the game low volatility with a 5,000x maximum, and the RTP is 96.96%. That combination of low volatility and high RTP makes it one of the gentler games in this database, similar to Aztec Magic Deluxe.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
